scope: Community pharmacy study decks: whether every drug, dose, age limit and counselling point matches the course sources, and whether the slides help a pharmacy student revise.
criteria: Every drug, dose, frequency and duration on a slide matches the source page it comes from.
Age limits, pregnancy and breastfeeding statements match the sources; contradictions in the sources are shown as 'to be confirmed'.
Viral and bacterial features, complications and referral or surgery indications are complete and correct.
MCQs come from the course quizzes, have one defensible key, and the reason cites the source fact.
Slides carry few words, use diagrams where the content has a shape, and use the sources' pictures where they help.
exclusions: Do not add drugs, doses or guidance that are not in the course sources.
evidence_expectations: Quote the slide text and the source page for every finding.
Give replacement text, not only a critique.
